People: Paul Belloni Du Chaillu (author, Wikidata Q749495), died 1903. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Du Chaillu, Paul B. (Paul Belloni), 1835-1903") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The Viking Age: The Early History, Manners and Customs of the Ancestors of the English-Speaking Nations; illustrated from the Antiquities discovered in Mounds, Cairns and Bogs as well as from the Ancient Sagas and Eddas, in Two Volumes, Vol. I, John Murray (London), 1889, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/india.history.resource.84494.
